title: Sceptre of Nefertiti
summary: The Sceptre of Nefertiti was an ancient artifact that contained the spell Neverlost. It was buried in the Tomb of Nefertiti before falling into the hands of the Organization.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The sceptre was sealed deep within the Tomb of Nefertiti and protected by a series of deadly traps and riddles. It was eventually acquired by the Huntik Foundation. However, in order to escape the Organization forces, Dante Vale threw the sceptre into a waterfall to allow the team time to escape and it was recovered by Klaus' Suits. However Dante then revealed he had placed tracking device on the sceptre which would lead them to Klaus' bookshop. [The Sceptre Deception]

After Klaus received the sceptre and learned the Neverlost spell, he destroyed it, feeding it to his spider creations, because he had scanned the spell Neverlost into his Teknonomicon. [The Bookshop Hunter]
